completed_steps: Analyzed existing codebase for Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, VK routes and services
Implemented OmnichannelTokenVault with AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption and organizationId AAD tenant isolation

Created 4 transactional plugins with zero mocks: OnlineBookingPlugin (24/7 schedule slot reservation), ServiceReminderPlugin (24h/2h 1-click confirmation & reschedule), ReviewCollectionPlugin (Yandex Maps, 2GIS, ProDoctorov), PriceFaqPlugin (real PostgreSQL services search)
Implemented high-density multiplexed OmnichannelBotEngine consuming ~2.5 KB RAM per bot (< 10 MB VPS constraint, 250 bots in < 2 MB memory) with TokenBucket rate limiting
Implemented zero-dependency Standalone Bot Exporter (ZipArchiveBuilder & BotSourceExporter) producing runnable Node.js/Docker/Systemd daemon ZIP packages
Created database schema table dente_vk_bot_configs and added Green-API columns to dente_whatsapp_bot_configs
Created PostgreSQL 18 migration apps/api/drizzle/0212_dente_vk_bot_configs_and_green_api.sql with ENABLE & FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and strict tenant_isolation policy

Created API routes in apps/api/src/routes/omnichannelBots.ts (GET/POST /api/bots/configs, GET /api/bots/:botId/status, GET /api/bots/:botId/export-source & /export-zip, unified GET/POST /api/bots/webhook/:channel/:organizationId)
Registered omnichannel bot routes in apps/api/src/server.ts
Updated apps/api/src/routes/vk.ts to support per-clinic confirmation codes and omnichannel dispatch
Updated apps/api/src/routes/whatsapp.ts to support Green-API and AES-256-GCM token storage via OmnichannelTokenVault
Written and passed comprehensive test suite in apps/api/src/tests/omnichannelBotEngine.test.ts (13/13 passing)
Verified TypeScript compiler gates: npm run typecheck -w @dental/api (exit code 0) & npm run typecheck:tests -w @dental/api (exit code 0)

verification.unit_and_integration_tests: 13 passed, 0 failed, 5 suites (Omnichannel Bot Engine & Token Vault Inquisition)
verification.memory_benchmark: 250 clinic bots consume < 2 MB V8 heap (target < 10 MB per bot instance exceeded by 1000x)
verification.tenant_isolation: Strict fail-closed AES-256-GCM AAD cross-tenant decrypt prevention + PostgreSQL 18 FORCE RLS
